run_lm_harness_eval: run the LM Harness evaluation on a consolidated HierarchicalTransformer model checkpoint using simple_evaluate
run_validation_eval: run validation evaluation on JSONL sources to compute NLL, NLL per token, and NLL per char metrics
create_eval_harness_lm_wrapper: create an EvalHarnessLM wrapper around a PackedHierarchicalCausalTransformerGenerator for lm-eval harness compatibility
run_eval_with_config: run evaluation via main() by passing a config file path and optional CLI dot-list overrides through OmegaConf
consolidate_and_load_checkpoint: consolidate checkpoints from ckpt_dir and load the HierarchicalTransformer model with tokenizer for evaluation
